It then decodes CPUID vendor/model bits to build a human-readable CPU name and sets a performance tier (0-4) and feature flags (MMX/SSE/3DNow). Finally it queries GlobalMemoryStatus and stores physical/page memory sizes in the output struct; if a caller-supplied secondary object a2 has a positive field, it hands the name buffer and two output fields to sub_55BE20. State machine on the object mode field: case 1 = TCP receiver (select + recv into a shared 2047-byte buffer, optional XOR/RC4 decryption, packet header parse and dispatch to audio note/param handlers); case 2 = UDP receiver (select + recvfrom, validity check, port-based dispatch); case 3 = alternate receiver handler. Closes and resets the socket on read failure, timeout, or end-of-stream, and notifies the audio system via AudioValueSetterCall.

TCP case: select() on the socket at this+0x88 with a zero timeout; if not readable, return 0 (idle).
TCP case: recv() appends up to (2047 - dword_8CFAE0) bytes of the socket into the shared receive buffer byte_8CF288 at the current length offset dword_8CFAE0.

TCP case: if the remaining unparsed bytes (cursor minus buffer base) are within 6 bytes of the buffer end, skip parsing: sub_58B130(byte_8CF288, cursor, dword_8CFAE0) compacts/resets the buffer and return 0.

TCP case: while the packet at the cursor starts with the aFinal marker (sub_588640(cursor, aFinal, 7) true) and the end-flag at this+0x74 is clear: parse one packet header; if fewer than 6 bytes remain, finish via the buffer-compact path.

TCP case, stream end: after the parse loop exits, closesocket, set the socket at this+0x88 to -1, reset dword_8CFAE0 to 0; if the protocol flag at this+0x90 is 6 or 7 notify AudioValueSetterCall(this, 0), otherwise AudioValueSetterCall(this, 3); return 0.

UDP case: select() on the socket at this+0x88 with a zero timeout; loop while readable; recvfrom() up to 1499 bytes into a local buffer with a 16-byte sockaddr source; if sub_587C20(buffer, aFinal) confirms a valid audio packet, byte-swap the source port with ntohs and dispatch via TwoStepDispatch(this, port); on -1 fall back to ConditionalNetworkUtility(this, port, 5).

UDP case, timeout: if GetTickCount() minus the last-activity timestamp at this+0x8C exceeds 0xBB8 (3000 ms) with no packet, closesocket, set the socket at this+0x88 to -1 and notify AudioValueSetterCall(this, 3); return 0.
